# McLelun

> > Digital art resource site specializing in anime-style background painting, Photoshop techniques, and animation workflows inspired by Studio Ghibli and Makoto Shinkai.

McLelun is a personal portfolio and tutorial site by a digital artist focused on anime background art, featuring step-by-step Photoshop tutorials, Blender3D integration techniques, and color theory guides. The site showcases both educational content and original artwork spanning environment design, custom brush creation, and post-production effects.

## Key Topics

- Photoshop
- Blender3D
- AfterEffects
- anime-style-art
- background-art
- digital-painting

- Studio Ghibli
- Makoto Shinkai

## Anime Background Painting Tutorials

- [Anime Tree Tutorial](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/10/anime-tree-tutorial.html): Photoshop tutorial on painting anime-style trees inspired by Ghibli artists
- [Anime Cloud Tutorial](https://www.mclelun.com/2016/05/anime-cloud-tutorial.html): Photoshop tutorial for painting anime-style cumulus clouds using brushes
- [Painting Anime Bus Stop Scene](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/11/painting-bus-stop-scene.html): Tutorial on anime background painting using Blender3D and Photoshop workflow
- [What is Shadow Color?](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/10/what-is-shadow-color.html): Color theory guide on using blue/cyan/purple hues for anime shadow painting
- [Photoshop Paint Over Photo For Anime Style Outdoor Highway Scene](https://www.mclelun.com/2018/12/photoshop-paint-over-photo-for-anime.html): Timelapse collection of photo-to-anime background art conversion techniques

## Photoshop Custom Brushes & Effects

- [Enhancing Your Anime Artwork Using Blur Filter](https://www.mclelun.com/2021/01/enhancing-your-anime-artwork-using-blur.html): Post-production guide using Gaussian/Box/Lens blur for depth & bokeh effects
- [Creating Photoshop Aurora Northern Lights Brush](https://www.mclelun.com/2018/11/creating-photoshop-aurora-northern.html): Quick tutorial for creating custom aurora/northern lights Photoshop brush
- [Creating Photoshop Dandelion Brush From Photo](https://www.mclelun.com/2018/07/creating-photoshop-dandelion-brush-from.html): Tutorial on converting photos into custom globe-shaped flower brushes

## Environment Design & Portfolio Work

- [Sunsastera Environment Design](https://www.mclelun.com/2017/03/sunsastera-environment-design.html): Award-winning Malaysia IPCC animation backgrounds and environment design
- [Painting Anime Suburban Scene](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/10/painting-anime-suburban-scene.html): Painting log of anime-style suburban background with Photoshop workflow
- [Evening Lake Scene Painting](https://www.mclelun.com/2016/04/evening-lake-scene-painting.html): 45-minute speed painting combining Blender3D tree renders with Photoshop

## Animation Projects

- [Keep Drawing](https://www.mclelun.com/2016/12/keep-drawing.html): Motivational animation for artists using Photoshop, AfterEffects, Blender3D
- [Hujan animation](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/10/hujan-animation.html): Rain-themed background animation using Blender3D dynamic paint & Photoshop
- [Butterfly Animation](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/10/butterfly-animation.html): Short animation created overnight using Blender3D and AfterEffects
- [Blue Evening](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/11/blue-evening.html): 5-hour weekend project compositing landscape art into animated sequence
- [Strange Things Caught On Security Camera Animation](https://www.mclelun.com/2017/07/strange-things-caught-on-security.html): Security camera-style asteroid impact animation in AfterEffects & Photoshop

## Optional

- [Comic Using Flash Vector](https://www.mclelun.com/2016/11/comic-using-flash-vector.html): Portfolio collection of Flash vector comics from 2008-2011
- [When you ask your friends if they watch anime](https://www.mclelun.com/2016/01/when-you-ask-your-friends-if-they-watch.html): Webcomic about social isolation when discussing anime with friends
- [Guy VS Cat](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/11/guy-vs-cat.html): Comic created with CloudAlpaca/FireAlpaca drawing applications
- [Hamster Powered Toaster](https://www.mclelun.com/2015/10/hamster-powered-toaster.html): Humorous comic featuring HPT 2000 concept art and scientist character
